name: safebits
description: safebits: weekly batch-cooking planner PWA for Spain

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @safebits/back -w @safebits/front
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run build:lint && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && biome lint --error-on-warnings && node tools/lint/dist/no-comments/cli.js && npm run lint:architecture
scripts.lint:architecture: depcruise safebits_front/src safebits_back/src packages/shared/src tools/lint/src --config .dependency-cruiser.json --output-type err
